opennyai_summary.decision:
Pending the said case, petitioner No.1/A1 and 2nd respondent/de facto complainant herein filed FCOP No.1066 of 2022 on the file of the learned IV Additional District Judge-cum-Judge, Principal Family Court, Vijayawada, seeking decree of divorce by way of mutual consent.
The learned Additional District Judge, by an order dated 03.02.2023, allowed the said FCOP, granting decree of divorce, dissolving the marriage between A1 and the de facto complainant on the SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO.
NOTE ground of their mutual consent.
A perusal of the said order goes to show that the parties have settled their disputes amicably and certain terms and conditions have been entered into between them.
It has been agreed between both the parties that they will not file any civil and criminal cases against each other in future.
Having entered into a compromise, the de facto complainant has not come forward for withdrawal of the present case that has been filed against the petitioners herein.
In view of the aforesaid reasons, there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings in CC No.6604 of 2022 on the file of the learned II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Vijayawada, for a period of eight (8) weeks.
